meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网址、设计稿或一段文字变成带动态效果的视频或动画画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把现成素材快速做成视频或动态画面
copy.tagline_en: Turn a URL, design, or brief into an animated video or motion graphic
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn existing material into a video or motion graphic

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把视频、动画、动效类请求当作统一入口:先读取项目状态,自动选择并安装对应工作流,最后用 HTML 合成渲染出视频。
howto.when: 当你提出制作、编辑或渲染视频、动画、动效图的请求,或要检查、预览、发布已有 HyperFrames 项目时触发。

say.text: 把这个网站 URL 做成一段产品宣传视频
给这段口播素材加字幕,画面不要改
看看这个 HyperFrames 项目现在的时间线

howto.what_en: Claude treats video, animation and motion-graphic requests as one entry point: it reads project state, selects and installs the matching workflow, then renders video from HTML compositions.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any request to make, edit, animate or render a video, animation or motion graphic, or to inspect, preview, publish or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project.

say_en.text: Turn this website URL into a product promo video
Add captions to this talking-head footage without changing it
Show me the current timeline of this HyperFrames project
say_en.note: Runs the timeline command instead of reading files
